name: Markdown Converter
description: Convert between Markdown and HTML and count headings, links and code blocks.

hints.input: Markdown parsing reuses goldmark and HTML parsing uses a standard parser.
hints.output: HTML to Markdown maps common tags to equivalent syntax and skips script and style content.
